name: Blue Ribbon Challah
description: As sumptuous as it is striking, Uncle Mimi's challah is the perfect addition to your Shabbat table or festive dinner. Delicious on its own or as a base for French toast!

image.alt: Two loaves of glossy, golden braided challah resting in a woven wicker basket.

name: Focaccia
description: If you are looking for a deeply savory, ultra flavorful bread, try this award winning focaccia.

image.alt: A round, golden focaccia loaf crowned with fresh rosemary and flaky sea salt on a wooden board.

name: Jerusalem Bagels
description: Light and airy, these elongated, oval street-style bagels feature a soft, bread-like crumb and a delicate crust. Perfect for tearing apart and pairing with your favorite savory dips.

image.alt: Several oval Jerusalem-style bagels topped with sesame and za'atar seed blends, fresh from the oven on parchment paper.

name: Mini Molten Chocolate Cakes
description: Crafted with high-quality dark chocolate and pure butter, these warm mini lava cakes deliver a soft baked exterior with a luscious chocolate center in every bite.

image.alt: A row of twelve mini chocolate lava cakes in brown paper liners, each topped with powdered sugar and a fresh raspberry.

name: Cinnamon Brown Sugar Coffee Cake
description: Nostalgic and decadent. Always generously portioned.

image.alt: Thick squares of marbled cinnamon brown sugar coffee cake stacked on a glass dish.

name: Delicious Apple Cake
description: It's all in the name. Made from a prized family recipe.

image.alt: A whole round apple cake topped with cinnamon sugar and chopped walnuts, served in a blue-and-white striped bowl.

name: Chocolate "Wave" Cake
description: A light and airy chocolate cake with a perfectly balanced sweetness — simple, delicate, and sure to satisfy every craving.

image.alt: A dark chocolate bundt-shaped cake dusted with powdered sugar, sliced into wave-like scalloped pieces on a plate.

name: Olive Oil Cake
description: Rich and tender, our Olive Oil Cake offers a soft, golden crumb with a subtle fruity depth and bright notes of fresh citrus. This is an elegant classic that pairs beautifully with fresh berries, a dollop of whipped cream, or a warm cup of coffee.

image.alt: A round golden olive oil cake dusted with a powdered-sugar pinwheel pattern, on a black plate with a lace doily.

name: Vegan-Friendly "Wacky" Chocolate Cake
description: An iconic 1930s classic! Our 'Wacky' Chocolate Cake uses traditional pantry ingredients to create an impossibly soft, rich chocolate sponge without any dairy or eggs.

image.alt: A round chocolate cake with a glossy chocolate drizzle in a crosshatch pattern, in a white bakery box.
A rattan basket of golden, cranberry-studded scones.

name: "Shiny Bottom" Brown Butter Oatmeal Cookies
description: Ultra-thin oatmeal lace crisps with a glassy, caramelized toffee bottom. Golden, crunchy, and packed with flavor.

image.alt: A pile of thin, golden-brown oatmeal lace cookies with a glossy caramelized bottom, cooling on a wire rack.

name: Granola
description: Naturally vegan-friendly, gluten-free, slightly sweet, and absolutely addictive.

image.alt: A close-up of golden, clustered granola studded with pumpkin seeds and dried cranberries.
